rahu.name: Rahu
rahu.shortDesc: North Node of the Moon — the point where the Moon's orbit intersects the ecliptic
rahu.fullDesc: Rahu in Vedic astrology is the North Node of the Moon — where the Moon crosses the ecliptic from south to north. It is not a physical body but a calculated point with strong symbolic weight.
rahu.westernEquivalent: North Node of the Moon / Dragon's Head (Caput Draconis)

ketu.name: Ketu
ketu.shortDesc: South Node of the Moon — the point opposite to Rahu
ketu.fullDesc: Ketu in Vedic astrology is the South Node of the Moon, opposite Rahu. It symbolizes past experience, spirituality, and letting go — releasing old patterns.
ketu.westernEquivalent: South Node of the Moon / Dragon's Tail (Cauda Draconis)
ketu.example2: Helps let go of the past

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.shortDesc: Planet of discipline, karma, and long-term results
saturn.fullDesc: Saturn is the slowest planet in astrology, symbolizing time, discipline, responsibility, and long lessons. It rewards steady work and exposes shortcuts.
saturn.westernEquivalent: Saturn — planet of structure and limitations

mars.name: Mars
mars.shortDesc: Planet of action, energy, and aggression
mars.fullDesc: Mars is the planet of action, drive, initiative, and conflict. It rules physical strength, courage, and defending your interests. In Vedic astrology — Mangala.
mars.westernEquivalent: Mars — planet of war and passion

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.shortDesc: Planet of communication, intellect, and commerce
mercury.fullDesc: Mercury is the planet of thinking, communication, learning, and trade. It rules intellect, speech, writing, and exchange. In Vedic astrology — Budha.
mercury.westernEquivalent: Mercury — planet of mind and connection

venus.name: Venus
venus.shortDesc: Planet of love, beauty, and harmony
venus.fullDesc: Venus is the planet of love, relationships, beauty, art, and comfort. It rules aesthetics, pleasure, and material ease. In Vedic astrology — Shukra.
venus.westernEquivalent: Venus — planet of love and beauty

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.shortDesc: Planet of wisdom, expansion, and luck
jupiter.fullDesc: Jupiter is the most benefic planet — wisdom, knowledge, spirituality, prosperity, and growth. It rules teachers, philosophy, and faith. In Vedic astrology — Guru.
jupiter.westernEquivalent: Jupiter — planet of luck and abundance

sun.name: Sun
sun.shortDesc: Symbol of soul, ego, and life force
sun.fullDesc: The Sun is the central luminary — soul, ego, self-expression, and life force. It rules leadership, authority, and self-worth. In Vedic astrology — Surya.
sun.westernEquivalent: Sun — symbol of personality and will

moon.name: Moon
moon.shortDesc: Symbol of mind, emotions, and subconscious
moon.fullDesc: The Moon symbolizes mind, emotions, intuition, and the subconscious. It rules mood, memory, care, and public feeling. In Vedic astrology — Chandra.
moon.westernEquivalent: Moon — symbol of emotions and instincts

onboarding.slide1Subtitle: Not a horoscope. A plan for today.
onboarding.slide1Description: One birth date — and you see what kind of day it is for you: when it’s easier to start, and when to ease off.
onboarding.slide2Description: Each day has a character. We explain it in plain language: what may fit, and what can wait.
onboarding.slide3Description: Open in the morning → read a short takeaway → decide how to shape the day. A prompt to think, not an order.

onboarding.nameHint: So it feels personal: “For you, Anna”

calendar.zeroDayHint: 10, 20, 30 — ease off big moves if you can
calendar.zeroDayDescription: On these dates it’s often easier to finish and tidy than to open major new work — if you have a choice.
calendar.tapForMore: Tap for full day · more tips
calendar.firstHint: Start with the “Today” card — takeaway and what fits
calendar.yesterdayCheckIn: Yesterday you marked {{score}}/5 — we keep that in mind
calendar.storyBodyFavorable: A good moment to move things you’ve been postponing. Interview, launch, or an important talk — the day may feel a bit easier than usual.
calendar.storyBodyHard: Worth slowing down a little. If you can, skip conflicts and rushed decisions. Closing open loops often works better than opening new ones.
calendar.storyBodyNeutral: An ordinary steady day. Good for routine, focused work, and small steps — without racing or sharp starts.
calendar.habitNudge: Day {{count}} in a row · tomorrow has a different rhythm — check in the morning
calendar.legendCompletionHint: Better to finish and protect energy than force ahead
calendar.legendZeroHint: 10, 20, 30 — postpone big moves if you can

dayDetail.zeroDayDesc: If you have a choice, it’s calmer to close tasks than to force a big start. Not a ban — a soft cue.
dayDetail.favorableDesc: You can take braver steps — if you feel ready
dayDetail.completionDesc: Easier to finish and tidy than to force a launch
dayDetail.neutralDesc: An ordinary day: keep a comfortable pace
dayDetail.disclaimer: This is an interpretation from a chosen calculation system. Use it as a prompt to reflect — not as the only basis for decisions.

1.name: Sun
1.title: Initiative day
1.description: Easier to take the first step. If you’ve been postponing a start — this day may fit.
1.shortDesc: Easier to begin and show up
1.fullDesc: The energy of the Sun brings clarity, leadership, and new beginnings. This is your time to take bold steps and initiate important projects.
1.advice: If you feel ready — move something important off dead center

2.name: Moon
2.title: Relationship day
2.description: A good moment for close people and calm talks. Hard negotiations — only if you must.
2.shortDesc: Softer with people, careful with pressure
2.fullDesc: The Moon's energy brings emotional sensitivity and receptivity. Not recommended for launching new business ventures. Focus on relationships and diplomacy.
2.advice: If you can — choose diplomacy over argument
positive: Time with family and close ones

3.name: Jupiter
3.title: Growth day
3.description: Good for learning, widening plans, and calm progress.
3.fullDesc: Jupiter's expansive wisdom brings growth and opportunity. Perfect time for analysis, structure, and signing contracts.
3.advice: You can strengthen what already works — without fanaticism
negative: Promise more than you can carry

4.name: Rahu
4.title: Change day
4.description: Surprises may show up. Flexibility helps more than a rigid plan.
4.fullDesc: Rahu (North Lunar Node) energy amplifies desires and material pursuits. Good for setting ambitious goals, but watch for obsessions. Western equivalent: North Node / Dragon's Head
4.advice: Keep the goal, leave a backup plan

5.name: Mercury
5.title: Communication day
5.description: Easier to talk, write, sell, and stay in touch. Good for negotiations if you’re ready.
5.fullDesc: Mercury supports communication and networking. Many projects will yield stable results during this period.
5.advice: If you need a conversation — today is often easier to start it
negative: Stay silent when a clear answer is needed

6.name: Venus
6.title: Balance day
6.description: A good moment for family, care, and inner balance. If you can — skip unnecessary conflict.
6.fullDesc: Venus brings harmony and beauty. Time for enjoying life, completing old tasks, quality purchases, and investments.
6.advice: You can slow the race and care for what is “close to home”
negative: Carry others’ problems beyond your limit

7.name: Ketu
7.title: Quiet day
7.description: Worth slowing down a little. A calm pace often leads to better decisions.
7.fullDesc: Ketu (South Lunar Node) brings spiritual insights through letting go. Time for meditation, therapy, and releasing old patterns. Western equivalent: South Node / Dragon's Tail
7.advice: If you can — choose depth over busyness
negative: Fill the day with noise to feel busy

8.name: Saturn
8.title: Discipline day
8.description: Good for finishing and structure. Big new launches — only if truly needed.
8.fullDesc: Saturn rewards discipline and hard work. Perfect time for signing contracts and making important decisions. Just work hard and success will follow!
8.advice: One finished result beats three starts

9.name: Mars
9.title: Completion day
9.description: Good for closing cycles and letting go. New starts — only without strain.
9.fullDesc: Mars brings energy for finishing what you started. High emotional intensity. Time for summing up results and cleansing.
9.advice: Ask: what is time to close — and close it calmly
negative: Cling to what no longer works
warnings: Discipline and sports will help find balance
Retribution for violations will be quick

marsNegotiations.title: How Mars Affects Negotiations
marsNegotiations.scenario: Important business negotiations or signing a contract
marsNegotiations.goodTiming: Mars is favorable for closing deals, not for starting new ones. If your personal day is 9, it's time to wrap up and close current issues.
marsNegotiations.badTiming: Starting new negotiations on day 9 is risky — conflict or aggression may arise from both sides.
marsNegotiations.tip1: On day 9, focus on completion, not beginning
marsNegotiations.tip2: If negotiations drag on — postpone to day 1 (Sun) for a fresh start
marsNegotiations.tip3: On day 9, it's better to sign the final contract than to start discussions
marsNegotiations.tip4: Control your emotions — Mars intensifies irritability

mercuryPresentations.title: Presentations and Public Speaking
mercuryPresentations.scenario: Important project presentation or public speech
mercuryPresentations.goodTiming: Day 5 (Mercury) — perfect time for communication. Your words will find response, arguments will be convincing.
mercuryPresentations.badTiming: Day 7 (Ketu) — energy of isolation and inner work. The speech may not have the expected effect.
mercuryPresentations.tip2: Day 5 is also great for networking
mercuryPresentations.tip3: Prepare in advance — Mercury loves details

jupiterStartup.title: Launching a New Project or Startup

jupiterStartup.badTiming: Day 2 (Moon) — energy of uncertainty and doubts. Decisions may be emotional, not rational.
jupiterStartup.tip1: Jupiter is the planet of luck — use day 3 for important launches
jupiterStartup.tip2: Also good for signing contracts and agreements
jupiterStartup.tip3: Day 3 is favorable for learning and gaining knowledge

venusDate.badTiming: Day 8 (Saturn) — energy of work and discipline. The date may seem too serious or boring.
venusDate.tip2: Day 6 is favorable for expensive purchases and investments
venusDate.tip3: Go on a trip — Venus loves comfort
venusDate.tip4: Avoid empty spending — focus on quality

saturnContract.tip3: Day 8 is good for starting new activities

moonRelationships.tip1: Day 2 — time for diplomacy and compromise
moonRelationships.tip2: Visit theaters and museums — Moon loves art

tour.welcomeBody:
It’s simple.

1) The formula calculates your personal day from birth date.
2) You get a short takeaway: what may fit today.
3) The helper connects that to your plans.

Not a horoscope and not an order — a cue to think.
tour.welcomeTip: Six short steps — under a minute.
tour.todayBody:
The main place on the screen.

• Day number (1–9) — your personal rhythm for this date
• Color dot — action / steady / pause
• Short takeaway and 3 “may fit” points

Tap the card for the full day breakdown.
tour.todayTip: Start the morning here — one glance is often enough.
tour.colorsBody:
Green — action day: starts, meetings, decisions (if ready).

Yellow — steady day: routine without extremes.

Red — pause day: better to finish and protect energy if you can choose.

Indigo (10, 20, 30) — go softer on big moves.
tour.colorsTip: Color is a cue, not a ban. You always decide.
tour.gridBody:
Each square is a date and your personal day number.

• Swipe left/right — change month
• Tap a day — details
• Today has a highlight ring

Plan meetings and launches with a clear view ahead.
tour.checkinBody:
In the evening you can rate how well the take matched reality (1–5) and note what happened.

That’s your personal memory. Over time the helper can use your ratings — not “magic”.
tour.checkinTip: Even one check-in a week helps.
